what: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.105 launched by Hive (its own launch plugin, HI-1960) when its model's API can't be reached: offline BYOK (COPILOT_OFFLINE=true, COPILOT_MODEL=gpt-4.1, a dummy COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY) in a new COPILOT_HOME with an empty GH_CONFIG_DIR and gh off PATH, COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL a closed port on 127.0.0.1 (refused) or a host under .invalid (notFound); one prompt, 'reply ok'. The hooks Hive received (its developer console, text shown; the error's stack left out) and the session.error Copilot wrote to events.jsonl. An ErrorOccurred for each of its 6 tries, every one recoverable: true, the last too; no Stop; the turn ends with the session.error (3 ms after the last hook). Nothing reached a real model. Ids, folders and the port replaced.
